status: declared before any score (#410, track X of #374); a scratch measurement, nothing published moves
form: logistic stacking on the logits of the members' probabilities
comparison_note: the arithmetic mean of the members' probabilities, no fit; it separates what the weights add from what averaging adds
members_note: ngboost_laplace, hierarchical_logistic and qrf are the members with the best onset recall at the judge's amended cut-offs (#416); the hazard and tail are merged tracks of other families. Not stacked: the rare-event and policy tracks (no merged forecast file), the hurdle and Markov-switching tracks (their pull requests were still open).
design: for each threshold and horizon: log-odds of P(spread > tau) = intercept + sum_m w_m * logit(clip(p_m)), p_m member m's probability for the day

fit.method: Newton's method on the penalised log loss; the intercept is not penalised
fit.penalty: (ridge / 2) * sum_m (w_m - 1/M)^2, the pull being towards the equal-weight logit pool

refit.blocks: the judge's blocks: scored days 0..20, 21..41, ... of the shared fold grid
refit.training_window: the scored days of earlier blocks whose outcome was public at the block's first decision instant, as pressure_judge.choose_cutoffs reads it: up to the business day h + 1 business days before the block's first scored day
refit.members_read: each member's own walk-forward probabilities, made before the refit, out of sample when made

fallback.rule: the equal-weight logit pool (intercept 0, every weight 1/M)
fallback.when: the training window has fewer than 126 scored days, or fewer than 5 pressure days at the threshold, or fewer than 5 days without

scoring: pressure_judge.py judge, the declaration of metadata/pressure_judge.json, scored days 2018-06-29 to 2025-12-31 only; the stack and its comparison row are candidates there, each member alone is a row beside them
